newsitem.title: USA: T-HQ Inc to offer 1.5 million shares.
newsitem.headline: T-HQ Inc to offer 1.5 million shares.

text.p: T-HQ Inc said on Monday it has filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission to offer 1.5 million shares of common stock, all of which are being sold by the company.
On December 20, 1996, the last reported sale price of the common stock was $9.875 per share, the company said.
The company said it anticipates that the offering will commence in March 1997 after the release of the company's audited financial statements for 1996.
A registration statement relating to these securities has been filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission but has not yet become effective, the company said.
